rabbit: Production sprite sheet on TRANSPARENT background for a cozy hand-painted storybook bakery management game. EXACTLY 3 columns by 4 rows of 12 isolated full-body sprites, equal grid cells, no borders labels text background or floor. Character: an ivory white rabbit with long upright ears, pink inner ears, small round dark eyes, a muted sage-green short sleeveless vest, tiny brown satchel, no hat. SAME single character with consistent clothes, proportions and scale in every cell, feet at same baseline in each cell, all ears antlers tails fully included with ample transparent margins. 3 columns in EACH row are consecutive walking poses: LEFT FOOT forward, neutral passing stance, RIGHT FOOT forward. Row 1 faces diagonally FRONT LEFT (southwest); row 2 faces diagonally FRONT RIGHT (southeast); row 3 faces diagonally BACK RIGHT (northeast); row 4 faces diagonally BACK LEFT (northwest). Fixed isometric game camera about 25 degrees above eye level, same angle all frames. Distinct front and back views, do not repeat front-facing characters in back rows. No ground shadows outside feet, absolutely transparent background, no extra characters. Friendly original generic bakery customer, not a recognizable franchise character.
